"""探测 http://sut:9000/health。"""

HEALTH_URL = "http://sut:9000/health"


def healthy(status: int) -> bool:
    return status == 200

import importlib.util
from pathlib import Path

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("probe", Path(__file__).parent.parent / "probe.py")
probe = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(probe)


def test_healthy() -> None:
    assert probe.healthy(200)
    assert not probe.healthy(503)
